status: REGISTERED, NOT RUN. Committed before the first E27 1,000-node heterogeneous testbed run per PS-09-D1.
title: 1,000-node heterogeneous testbed (CUDA, ROCm, Metal profiles on residential network traces with 10-30% planted Byzantine nodes): convergence time, bandwidth per epoch, verification overhead, and routing latency gates

design.network_trace_source: PS-06 residential link profiles (asymmetric residential broadband up/down bandwidth and RTT distributions)

constraints.infrastructure: Spot VMs or local CPU-only harness only; Spot VMs deleted immediately after the run.

acceptance_rules_fixed_now.R1_replications: At least 3 independent seeded runs completed for each node count N in {100, 300, 1000}.
acceptance_rules_fixed_now.R2_convergence_and_bandwidth: Mean time-to-convergence <= time_to_convergence_ceiling_s[N] and mean bandwidth per epoch <= 25.0 MB/node.
acceptance_rules_fixed_now.R3_verification_and_routing: Verification/replay overhead <= 15.0% of epoch wall time and routing p95 latency <= 250.0 ms at N=1000.
acceptance_rules_fixed_now.R4_byzantine_resilience: Multi-Krum + execution-class-matched replay achieves >= 95% poisoner rejection recall with <= 5% honest false positives at 10%, 20%, and 30% planted fractions.

verdicts.PASS: R1 and R2 and R3 and R4
verdicts.FAIL_SCALING: R1 holds, R2 or R3 fails
verdicts.INVALID: R1 fails (fewer than 3 runs per size)

not_claimed: No E27 simulation run has been executed in this pre-registration file.
Emulated 1,000-node results do not replace real volunteer hardware enrollment receipts (PS-03-D1, PS-04-D2).
